context: Idempotency is the center of gravity of the whole track. ETL vs ELT, zones, data contracts; idempotent writes, deterministic partitioning, incremental vs full refresh; the Beam model (PCollections, transforms, shuffles, what/where/when/how); streaming semantics at PDE-exam depth: windowing types, watermarks and late data, triggers and accumulation modes, exactly-once vs at-least-once vs effectively-once, Pub/Sub acks/ordering keys/dead-letter queues; CDC log-based vs query-based; orchestration (DAGs, retries, backfill runs, Airflow/Composer vs Workflows, validation gates, CI/CD for pipelines).

topics: ETL vs ELT: Where Transformation Lives
Staging, Raw, and Curated Zones
Data Contracts Between Producers and Consumers
